title: Ragna's Broken Oar
offer: Ragna rowed out at dawn and is not back! I fear her oar broke. Find her on the lakes, then come back and fetch the spare oar for her.

steps.say: Hello! Yes, my oar broke, and I drift with one. Tell Tor to give you the spare one!
She is well? Thank the gods. Here is the oar: bring it to her!
My oar! Now I can row again. Here, take some fish: the freshest on the lakes.

fact: Every viking boat carried spare oars: a broken oar was common.
